seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Ypsilanti, Michigan for 2026: 3 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Ypsilanti's library lights the downtown tree and hosts a jazz holiday concert, and a Marriott breakfast brings Santa to Eagle Crest.
celebrates: Ypsilanti District Library anchors the city's 2026 holiday events, with the free Downtown Tree Lighting at the Michigan Avenue Library Plaza on December 4 and Paul Keller's Jolly Jazz Holiday Celebration at the Whittaker branch on December 6. The Ann Arbor Marriott Ypsilanti at Eagle Crest hosts a Breakfast with Santa on November 29. The Ypsilanti Artisans Holiday Markets, listed free by Destination Ann Arbor, run November 28 and 29 and December 19 and 20 for families who like to shop with kids.
lastyear: Earlier Ypsilanti tree lightings have centered on the library and on Depot Town, with listings describing Santa, Mrs. Claus, a youth choir and a petting farm at a past Depot Town lighting. The 2026 Depot Town lighting date has not been posted, so this page lists only the library events whose dates are confirmed.
facts: Ypsilanti District Library has branches on Michigan Avenue, Whittaker Road and Superior Road. The library's listing says free parking is available in the lot across Adams Street during the tree lighting, courtesy of MI-HQ. Ypsilanti is home to Depot Town, a historic district where a community tree lighting has been held in past years.
trains: Ypsilanti has no Santa train listed in 2026. Depot Town, a historic Ypsilanti district, hosted a tree lighting with Santa and Mrs. Claus in a past year, but no 2026 date is posted. The Michigan Transit Museum in Mount Clemens keeps its depot museum open on Sundays from 1 to 4 pm, and the Southern Michigan Railroad Santa Express in Clinton, Michigan, runs on select weekends from November 28 to December 13, 2026.
